package sandbox // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/sandbox"

func Base(o Options) ([]string, error)

func Binary(path string) (string, error)

func Check(ctx context.Context, binary string, args, env []string, command ...string) error

func ReapOrphans() int

func Run(ctx context.Context, binary string, args, env []string) (err error)

func RunChild(cmd *exec.Cmd) error

func RuntimeEnv() []string

func StartReaper(ctx context.Context)

type Options struct {
	Network bool
}

type Service struct {
	Prefix string

	DataDir string

	Executable string

	WriteDirs []string

	ReadFiles []string

	Env []string

	ForwardEnv []string

	NestedSandbox bool
}

func (s Service) Policy() (args, env []string, err error)
